summary.motive: Present an identical wide-zone run look to pull linebackers downhill and manipulate the single-high Free Safety with an intermediate crosser, opening an explosive deep post across the entire field.
summary.whyItWorks: The intermediate Over route by TE1 holds the single-high safety on the right hash, allowing the backside Z receiver on a Cross-Country Post to attack the vacant deep middle/left void with maximum leverage.
summary.failureMode: Free Safety remaining disciplined in the deep middle third or an unblocked edge rusher affecting the QB before the deep 7-step play-action platform is established.

beats.title: 1. The Identical Wide-Zone Mesh Illusion
beats.text: From the exact same 12-personnel condensed alignment, the offensive line and RB execute a full-velocity wide zone stretch fake left. All three linebackers and the safety step aggressively downhill into run fits.

beats.title: 2. The Play-Action Disconnect & Over Route Release
beats.text: QB executes a deep 7-step play-action drop. TE1 slips off his run fake and stems across the formation on a 12-yard intermediate Over route, drawing the eyes of both the strong safety and the deep middle free safety.

beats.title: 3. The Cross-Country Post Break
beats.text: Z receiver stems from the condensed right split, crosses the face of the right corner, and climbs across the entire formation at 22+ yards depth, slicing directly into the gaping void vacated by the lured Free Safety.

beats.title: 4. The 45-Yard Deep Touchdown Strike
beats.text: With clean 7-man protection in the pocket and X pinning the boundary corner deep, the QB launches a majestic 45-yard rainbow to Z streaking wide open across the opposite deep seam.

relations.tell: Tight end (TE1) releasing into the secondary after a 0.8-second delay rather than staying attached to the perimeter reach block.
